---
title: "Curriculum"
---

The academy curriculum is organized around **learning paths**. Each path
groups related courses that together move a learner from foundational ideas to
real, working systems.

## Compose → construct → behave

The academy's three core courses map onto the three phases of Open
Engineering — **Crossplane composes, Sandcastle constructs, Picos behave**:

| Phase | Question | Course |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Compose** | What should exist? | [Crossplane](../courses/crossplane/) |
| **Construct** | How is it safely built? | [Sandcastle](../courses/sandcastle/) |
| **Behave** | What does the resulting entity do? | [Pico](../courses/pico/) |

The learning paths below expand on this backbone. Pico is the runtime/behaviour
foundation for the other two, so learners generally take Pico first, then
Crossplane and Sandcastle in either order depending on interest.

## Planned learning paths

The initial catalog of learning paths (in various stages of development):

- Open Engineering Foundations
- Kubernetes for Open Engineering
- Crossplane
- Sandcastle
- Declarative Infrastructure
- Open Engineering Definitions
- Open Engineering Conventions
- Parsers
- Rules
- Capsules
- Composers
- Picos
- Wrangler
- Manifold
- Home Assistant Integration
- GitOps with FluxCD
- Building AI-native Engineering Systems

Each learning path can consist of multiple courses, and each course can be
divided into sections, lessons, labs, and quizzes.

## Reference course

The [pico course](../courses/pico/) is the first fully normalized
reference implementation and demonstrates the standard course-website
structure.

## Status

This page is an overview. Detailed roadmaps, prerequisites, and dependencies
between paths will be added as courses come online. See [Courses](../courses/index.qmd)
for the current course catalog.
